decision: Selected the centroid of Durham County tax parcel 0738519437 (99 T W ALEXANDER DR, owned by Compass Datacenters RDU I LLC), as published in the NC OneMap statewide parcel layer, as the reviewed site locator for TierPoint's Raleigh - RTP data center at 99 TW Alexander Drive, Durham.
layer: NC OneMap NC1Map_Parcels FeatureServer layer 1; Durham County source rows; native CRS EPSG:2264

0738519437.records: three stacked records with identical geometry: altparno 154120 (land, 11.94 acres, COM/ PARKING LOTS-SU, 99 T W ALEXANDER DR), 215427 (IND/ LSHLD IMPROV, improvements 4,210,509, 99 01 T W ALEXANDER DR) and 227753 (improvements 13,354,980, 99 2 T W ALEXANDER DR)

excluded.0738613267: 2864 E NC 54 HWY, 4.08 acres, VACANT INDUSTRIAL, same owner; not at the operator's address and carries no improvements, so it is not part of the locator.

operator_structured_data_point_check.falls_in: parcel 0738647347 (79 T W ALEXANDER DR, IND/ BIOTECH - BIOPH, 58.71 acres)
operator_structured_data_point_check.use: not used; latitude given to four decimals, consistent with an approximate street geocode

computed.method: Planar centroid of the WGS84 (outSR=4326) parcel polygon (the three stacked records share one geometry); cross-checked against the native EPSG:2264 centroid transformed with pyproj; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: TierPoint's Raleigh - RTP page (version of 3 September 2026) gives 'Raleigh (RTP) 99 TW Alexander Drive Durham, NC 27709'.
NC OneMap returns parcel 0738519437 with site address 99 T W ALEXANDER DR, owner COMPASS DATACENTERS RDU I LLC, and two leasehold-improvement records on the same parcel.

Compass Datacenters' news item of 1 May 2013 reports completing its first data center facility in Durham, within Research Triangle Park, leased by Windstream Hosted Solutions; TierPoint's release of 16 July 2019 announces the expansion of its RTP data center in partnership with Compass Datacenters.
unresolved: The parcel boundary locates the property, not the building footprint; the statewide layer gives no positional accuracy.
